agents.name: 📝 Qualidade de Código
agents.prompt: This is a code review for a BFF Fastify (TypeScript) project. Focus on TypeScript best practices, Fastify patterns, error handling, typing and code organization.

agents.name: 🏗️ Arquitetura
agents.prompt: This is an architecture review for a BFF Fastify (TypeScript) project. Focus on BFF separation of concerns, route organization, plugin structure, bounded contexts and coupling with backend services.

agents.name: 📋 Contrato de API
agents.summary: Expandir revisão de contrato de API
agents.prompt: This is an API contract review for a BFF Fastify (TypeScript) project. Focus on schema validation, backward compatibility, response types, versioning and contract consistency. If no API contract files were changed, confirm that briefly.

agents.name: ⚡ Performance
agents.prompt: This is a performance review for a BFF Fastify (TypeScript) project. Focus on async patterns, connection pooling, payload size, caching strategies, serialization overhead and response time impact.

agents.name: 📦 Changeset
agents.prompt: This is a changeset review for a BFF Fastify (TypeScript) monorepo PR. Focus on: changeset presence, semantic bump correctness, package coverage in frontmatter, description quality (Brazilian Portuguese, present tense, impact-focused, no commit prefixes, no technical names as subject), and ticket references.
